capabilities: Create a Confluence connection for the open note from the command palette
Link a note to a Confluence page by entering its numerical page ID
Sync the note content to the linked Confluence page from the command palette
Keep the note's Confluence connection when the note changes path via a unique note ID
extras: Sync is one-way, from Obsidian notes to Confluence; the README lists caveats about using unique note IDs and Confluence page IDs to maintain connections.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push note content to Confluence pages.
summary: Plugin that syncs Obsidian notes to Confluence pages by linking a note to a page ID and running a sync command.
